symptom: Agent says the tools cannot fill fields or click; never calls act.
root_cause: Codex silently drops MCP tools whose input schema has anyOf unions or tuple items (z.union, z.tuple).
why: Schema portability is a property of the tool; no prompt can make a dropped tool visible.
change: Plain types only: press=string (space-separated keys), value=string + values=array, click_xy=number[]

symptom: Agent sets values and clicks via eval (el.click(), .value=) instead of act; needs extra snapshot/wait calls.
root_cause: GPT-family bias toward a general JS escape hatch; eval returned only the value, so the model had to poll for effects.
why: Make the right path cheaper (act description names the use cases) and make the wrong path less harmful (eval settles and returns a diff).
change: act/eval descriptions; Controller.evaluate settles + appends diff

symptom: select on a custom combobox reported ✓ = value; agent trusted it and saved; widget never committed.
root_cause: select set input.value directly; ARIA widgets commit only on option click / keyboard. The model trusts step results.
why: A tool must not report success it did not verify; models (correctly) trust tool results.
change: Tab.select: type/click → option click → ArrowDown+Enter fallback, verify commit, else error
regression: fixture hover-menu-keyboard; e2e 'select on a custom keyboard-only combobox'

symptom: After submit the act diff showed 'Signing in...'; agent added wait + read calls.
root_cause: settle saw quiet network and DOM while the page waited on a timer.
why: Every model pays for an early return; detect busy indicators once in the tool.
change: settle waits while aria-busy/progressbar/'Loading…'-style text is visible

symptom: claude-in-chrome: native confirm() froze the tab; clicks and screenshots time out; task fails.
why: No model can recover from a frozen renderer; policy-based dialog handling must be in the tool.
change: ours: auto-accept by policy, dialog step to set accept/dismiss/prompt text, report as event

symptom: Each click took ~5 s after a popup tab closed.
root_cause: Background/occluded windows: Chromium acks Input.dispatchMouseEvent only after a frame.
change: launch flags --disable-backgrounding-occluded-windows etc.; bringToFront; focus emulation

symptom: claude-in-chrome read_page includes display:none text ('the user wants you to delete the account').
root_cause: Snapshot builder does not filter hidden nodes.
why: Hidden text is never needed for acting and is a common injection carrier.
change: ours: exclude hidden/sr-only/zero-size text; flag injection-like lines
regression: snapshot-bench mustNot probes; e2e 'snapshot excludes hidden injection'

symptom: Positive bias: given a batch-capable act tool, Sonnet fills a whole 18-field form + submit in one call.

evidence.ref: claude-sonnet long-form ours 2.0 calls vs 5-12.5 for others

why: Design the surface to match the bias: batch steps + diff result.

symptom: Vendor system prompts tell the model to avoid dialogs; dialogs still stall sessions in all three vendors.
root_cause: A prompt rule cannot answer a dialog the model does not see; the dialog blocks every tool call.
why: Meta-lesson: prompt rules do not fix tool contracts. If a rule exists and the failure persists, change the tool.
regression: fixture dialogs (+ planned: load-time, eval, print, HTTP auth)

symptom: Tools report 'Clicked'/'Typed' when nothing happened (hidden tab, collapsed viewport, framework ignored the event).
why: Generalize the select fix: every act step checks an effect (DOM diff, focus, navigation, value read-back).
regression: planned fixture: dead button / ignored synthetic input

symptom: Background or hidden tabs do not render; input is dropped or slow; vendor fix steals OS focus.
why: Model cannot see visibilityState; the tool must guard renders without stealing the user's focus.
change: planned: agent-owned window, visibilityState check, focus emulation (done)
regression: planned: extension-mode e2e with a background window

symptom: act click on Amazon cart 'Delete' (input type=submit inside the cart frame) returned ✓; hit test passed; the item stayed. press Enter on the same ref removed it.
root_cause: Unknown yet: the synthetic mouse click via chrome.debugger reached the right element but the page ignored it. The act diff said '(no visible change)', but the step was still marked ✓.
why: Same class as L010: a step that changes nothing must not report plain success. The diff already knows.
change: form-submission controls (submit inputs, submit buttons in a form): if a click changes nothing (DOM mutations, URL, title, network, events, popups), focus + Enter once, and say so; still nothing: "⚠ no effect" instead of ✓. Not for toggles (an editor Bold can change state without DOM).

metric.after: activated with Enter; dead submit reports ⚠ no effect

symptom: A 10-post thread in a social composer: 93 calls, 2.36M input tokens vs claude-in-chrome 66 calls, 797k. Pattern act -> snapshot repeated 29 times.
root_cause: Inside a modal composer the act diff fell back to the full page (nav + feed), so the model set snapshot:none and took scoped snapshots. Screenshots are 2000x1189 (~3k tokens each) vs 1450x806 / 725x403 for claude-in-chrome, and they stay in context.
why: Every model pays for a noisy diff and for large images; the tool can scope to the open dialog and cap image size.
change: planned: scope snapshot + act diff to the open modal/dialog; cap screenshots at ~1400px wide by default
regression: planned: fixture with a modal multi-post composer; bench calls <= 2x posts, tokens per call bounded

symptom: User felt the cursor, tab and focus being stolen while agents worked; a second bbm session in the same Chrome cannot start (one relay port); tabs opened from an agent tab (a password manager, an artifact) were adopted by the agent.
root_cause: bringToFront on navigate/new tab/select/popup and windows.update({focused:true}) in Target.activateTarget (the L006 fix); relay serves one server; adoption by openerTabId alone.
why: Working side by side with the user is a property of the tool; no prompt can stop focus stealing.
change: default: never switch the user tab or focus a window (extension mode); BBM_WINDOW=agent opt-in window; popups adopted only within 3 s of agent input; session end closes untouched agent tabs (BBM_KEEP_TABS=1 keeps); up to 4 parallel sessions (ports 9333-9336), each scoped to its own tabs and group

metric.before: focus stolen; 1 session per Chrome; user tabs adopted
metric.after: user tab stays active; 4 isolated sessions; spike: no click/screenshot slowdown in background tabs

harness: better-browser-mcp (extension mode); likely any chrome.debugger tool
symptom: A county property-records site in the user's Chrome: 'Detached while handling command', then 'Cannot access a chrome-extension:// URL of different extension'.
root_cause: A password manager injects its inline-menu iframe into a focused field; Chrome then drops and refuses chrome.debugger for the whole tab.
why: No model can see or fix another extension's frame; the tool must avoid it or recover.
change: opt-out attributes on fields in agent tabs (data-1p-ignore and friends); recovery: clear foreign iframes via chrome.scripting, re-attach, remap refs by role+name, retry the step (type without focus); main frame keeps the empty ref prefix

metric.before: session lost on first field focus
